headline: Steady leasing gains lift earnings as guidance rises
summary_short: Regency Centers' Q2 FY2026 diluted EPS rose 8.9% y/y to $0.61 as Same Property NOI grew 3.8% y/y to $288.3M and leasing spreads stayed strong (+10.4% cash / +19.5% straight-line); the company raised full-year 2026 Nareit FFO guidance to $4.84-$4.88 per share.
summary_long: Net income rose 8.9% y/y to $0.61/diluted share ($112.4M, +9.5% y/y) as Same Property NOI grew 3.8% y/y to $288.3M on 3.7 points of base-rent growth; total NOI rose 6.8% to $300.1M. Nareit FFO reached $1.21/share (+4.3% y/y) and Core Operating Earnings $1.16/share (+5.5% y/y). Occupancy held at 96.9% leased (+40bp y/y) with leasing spreads of +10.4% cash and +19.5% straight-line. Leverage was 5.0x net debt+preferred/EBITDAre with $1.5B of revolver capacity. Management raised full-year 2026 guidance for Nareit FFO ($4.84-$4.88/share), Core Operating Earnings ($4.62-$4.66/share), and Same Property NOI growth (3.7%-4.1%).

drivers.explanation: Base rent growth on existing same-property tenants accounted for 3.7 of the 3.8 percentage points of Same Property NOI growth this quarter.
CEO attributes the quarter to strong earnings and NOI growth, robust tenant demand, and continued momentum across the investments platform, without further numeric specifics.
